reason: My bookkeeper already puts everything in Jurnal and it works well enough. Half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a bot that reads photos doesn't fix my real gap. I might throw the 30 free ones at it out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay for a second system.
objection: Will it really catch a duplicate, or is it just a receipt-to-table bot? If the same fuel receipt comes in twice from two guys, or a parts invoice and a transfer screenshot for the same payment, I need to see it flag that. Otherwise it's just one more sheet next to Jurnal that my bookkeeper has to reconcile.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed the rows straight into Jurnal so my bookkeeper stops retyping, and on the free trial it actually flagged a double-sent receipt from my own staff.
